audit_items.proof_trace: Phase 1: `borrow_flash_loan` delegates exclusively to `flash_loan_withdraw` (L318-324), which only calls `underlying_balance.split(amount)` — it never touches `self.debt`. Phase 2: `repay_flash_loan` (L234-254) joins `underlying_balance` back and routes the fee through `increase_reserve_only` (L285-294), which only updates `self.cash` and `self.cash_reserve`, never `self.debt`. Phase 3: The only functions that mutate `self.debt` are `borrow_amount` (L199), `repay_amount` (L211/213), and `accumulate_interest` (L142) — none are invoked in the flash loan code path, confirming the invariant holds unconditionally.
